summary: the fakeapi suite on x86-64 against a fault in the plain protocol's check of a request and one in the server's verdict; the server is Python and runs as it is, so nothing is built

argv: ARCH=x86_64 exec sh tests/proofs/guest.sh run fakeapi 'fakeapi-test: PASS'

faults.name: path-ignored
faults.summary: proto_plain.py's check of the path is taken out, so the request the script does not expect plays the last step

lines: fakeapi-test: FAIL: the server answered a request its script does not expect

faults.name: unexpected-uncounted
faults.summary: fakeapi.py no longer counts an unexpected request as a failure, so the server's verdict passes the run

lines: fakeapi-test: FAIL: the server's verdict, status 0, did not fail the run for the unexpected request
